newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates rise at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates rise at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.28 percentage points to 1.30 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 98.84387 pesos.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 1.99 billion pesos, compared to the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
Meanwhile, the rate on the 728-day Bondes rose 0.01 percentage points to 1.37 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.82548 pesos.
Demand for the 728-day Bondes was 4.215 billion pesos, compared to the 700 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
